statements: Header compatibility with the Slice 1 library is complete for this revision: the catalog admitted all 18 headers under strict tiling, the index and the headers agree in both directions, and mlx-affine classified all 1126 module paths with zero refusals under the Slice 1 resolution rules. This is NOT Q0 payload identity and NOT numerical qualification.

This census agrees with the Slice 1 metadata compatibility record v2 for the same revision: the length-framed catalog digest is identical (15372d37...), as are the shard, tensor and module counts, the 126/542 split of 4-bit and 8-bit modules, the [288]/[64]/plain leading-shape counts and the vision totals.

Routed experts are quantized at the default (4-bit, group 64) and every other quantized module at an explicit 8-bit, group-64 override; all 542 overrides resolve to a quantized module whose shapes agree. Only 4/64/BF16 (126) and 8/64/BF16 (542) occur, both inside Slice 1's admitted domain.

Routed-expert weights are stacked with leading E=288 in MoE layers 3-44 (gate/up weight [288,2048,512], scales/biases [288,2048,64]; down weight [288,4096,256], scales/biases [288,4096,32]) and carry 94.1% of tensor bytes. The last plane of all 148 stacked triples (126 expert, 22 per-head MLA) ends exactly at its tensor's end under Slice 1's slicing arithmetic.

Two attention types alternate as config reports: 34 linear-attention layers (0-2,4-6,...,40-42,44) with 8-bit q/k/v_proj [8192,in 4096], b_proj, g_a/g_b and forget_gate f_a/f_b projections, an unquantized BF16 conv1d [24576,4,1], a BF16 o_norm and F32 A_log [64] and dt_bias [8192]; and 11 MLA/sparse-attention layers (3,7,...,43) with q_a/q_b/kv_a projections and per-head embed_q [64,512,in 256] and unembed_out [64,256,in 512]. o_proj takes in_features 8192 in the linear layers and 16384 in the MLA layers.

The indexer exists only in the 11 MLA layers and is quantized at 8 bits (wq_b in 1536, wk, weights_proj), with unquantized BF16 k_norm, index_kpool_compress_gate [128,4096] and index_kpool_compress_ape [4,128].
Every language-model layer carries hyper-connection parameters attn_hc and ffn_hc: fn BF16 [24,16384], base F32 [24], scale F32 [3] (config mhc true, hc_mult 4).
The vision tower (347 tensors, 1,127,254,016 bytes) is entirely unquantized BF16, as the Slice 1 rules file expected.
No next-token-prediction (MTP) tensors are present although config reports num_nextn_predict_layers 1: language-model layer indices stop at 44 of num_hidden_layers 45.
The index's metadata.total_size equals the sum of whole shard file sizes, not tensor bytes; the difference is exactly the 395,485 header bytes.

The download record for this revision holds only the repository, the revision, a local location (omitted) and a duration. It carries no per-file sizes, hashes or verification flags, so there is no recorded payload-identity receipt for this checkpoint beyond the revision pin.
